$comment: Platform preference for the review operation's seats (see scripts/lib/review-seat-settings.mjs). parallelSeats on|off: every juror seat of a review-pr run starts at once instead of one after another (tool override env WE_REVIEW_PARALLEL_SEATS). seatsByTouchSet on|off: the review daemon picks the seat list from the PR's touch-set before the run starts, so an all-prose PR (e.g. backlog cards only) does not seat the security juror; code PRs keep both mandatory seats (tool override env WE_REVIEW_SEATS_BY_TOUCH_SET). speculativeRedTeam on|off (scripts/lib/review-speculative-red-team.mjs): the review job starts the post-accept red team beside the juror seats and keeps it only on accept; deliberately NOT set here, so the platform preference (review.speculativeRedTeam in scripts/lib/delivery-platform-preferences.json) or the standard default (on) applies; set it here only to override for this repo (env WE_REVIEW_SPECULATIVE_RED_TEAM beats both).
